newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Telecom, Hutchison tie up in phone services.
newsitem.headline: Japan Telecom, Hutchison tie up in phone services.

text.p: Japanese long-distance phone operator Japan Telecom Co said on Monday that it would lease satellite communications circuits from Singapore's Hutchison Corporate Access for services in Asia.
The two firms will sign an agreement on Monday and Japan Telecom will announce details on Tuesday, he said.
Japan Telecom plans to connect its long-distance phone lines with circuits on Hutchison's communications satellite Asiasat 2, which covers the whole of Asia, he said.

Japanese telephone operators were previously restricted to small service areas but are now branching out into local and international services following deregulation and the restructuring of Nippon Telegraph and Telephone Corp.
Hutchison Corporate Access is a unit of the Hutchison Whampoa group.
